name: commandcode-pool
description: Vercel 多账号 Command Code 号池：支持 Go 套餐，提供 OpenAI / Anthropic / Responses 兼容 API

paragraphs: A production-ready multi-account pool for Command Code (commandcode.ai) deployed on Vercel. Provides unified OpenAI / Anthropic / Responses compatible endpoints with full support for the Go Plan (individual-go), including authentication, inference, and quota/usage tracking.
Referencing and integrating key architectural paradigms from:
features: MAXeaglet/commandcode-usage: Multi-account quota matrix, 5-hour & weekly rolling windows, monthly plan derivations.
MAXeaglet/commandcode-proxy: High-fidelity 1.53.1 CLI wire envelope (/alpha/generate), deterministic device fingerprinting, session management, zero-output guard, and protocol translation.
patlux/pi-commandcode-provider: Browser-assisted Studio OAuth authentication, Go plan transport fallback, and quota calculation.
Login & Auth: Automatically identifies the Go plan on registration via /alpha/whoami & /alpha/billing/subscriptions.

Add Account: Enter a Command Code API key (user... or tokenuser...) with an optional label.

Public /v1/ inference endpoints still require client APIKEYS and do not accept admin credentials.
